card.name: Right before the word AND
card.fires_on: The last piece of a word just before the word AND or the letters ANDI, mostly in all-caps label headings and in the brand name XTANDI or TREANDA.

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: The first part of a brand name such as XTANDI or TREANDA, where the next piece begins with AND.
modes.example: For patients who receive<< XT>>ANDI with or without a GnRH

modes.label: Caps heading before AND
modes.description: The end of a capitalized word in a heading just before AND, as in WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS or DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION.

card.writes: It suppresses the word and in several languages and promotes pieces like nd, so it pushes the next piece toward AND or ND spelling.
card.plain: It fires on a word that is about to be followed by AND, especially in all-caps headings and in drug names like Xtandi.
